title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the electrostatic potential phi must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the boundary conditions for the potentials at the surfaces of the hemispheres.

title: Legendre Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly expand the boundary condition function in terms of Legendre polynomials.

title: Laplace's Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly set up and recognize the form of Laplace's equation in spherical coordinates.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show the integration steps for calculating the coefficients of the Legendre polynomials.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the final expression are dimensionally consistent.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect coefficients in the Legendre expansion.

title: Neglecting Terms
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must correctly identify and neglect terms that fall off faster than 1/r^4.
